description: The plot illustrates the loss of different SepLLM models and a vanilla model before post-training over a range of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, and ranges from 90000 to 130000 in intervals of 5000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.0 to 2.8 in intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines: a magenta solid line representing SepLLM (n=64, larger lr), a blue solid line for SepLLM (n=128), an orange solid line for SepLLM (n=64), and a red dashed line for Vanilla before post-training. The magenta line starts at approximately 2.9 and decreases to around 2.2, showing a steady decline. The blue line begins at about 2.85 and ends at roughly 2.25, also decreasing steadily. The orange line starts at approximately 2.9 and decreases to around 2.28, following a similar trend. The red dashed line remains constant at 2.35 across the entire range of iterations. All three SepLLM lines exhibit a sharp decline initially, followed by a more gradual decrease as the number of iterations increases.
